title: Assessing the Potential of Generative Agents in Crowdsourced Fact-Checking

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the fact-checking accuracy of generative agents instantiated with different political affiliation prompts (Democrat, Republican, Independent) to see if ideological alignment affects their truthfulness assessments.
Comparing the fact-checking accuracy of generative agents instantiated with different ethnic identity prompts (White, Black) to evaluate performance variability across simulated racial demographics.
Comparing the fact-checking accuracy of generative agents instantiated with different gender identity prompts (Male, Female) to identify potential gender-based fluctuations in evaluation dynamics.
Comparing the fact-checking accuracy of generative agents instantiated with different simulated age ranges (19-25, 26-35, 36-50, 51-80) to evaluate demographic sensitivity.

Comparing the fact-checking accuracy of generative agents instantiated with different educational backgrounds (from 'Less than High School' to 'Post-graduate Degree') to assess subjective variability.
